Both upper arms, forearms, wrists, and empty hands remain complete and proportionate to the compact body; neither hand nor arm is inflated into an oversized generic chibi shape.
The matte black-and-white split-streak short textured crop, forward white section, side part, asymmetric top mass, and close side silhouette remain recognizably continuous with the summon.

The lilac-smoke fitted vest, soft shirt, broad folded collar, high-waist trousers, divided hem, flexible boots, tiny nose stud, closures, seams, and palette are preserved, but the three source ring-shaped hair ornaments have become three straight barrel hair clips rather than exactly three recognizable hair rings.

At original resolution, topmost hair is approximately y=149, the chin approximately y=625, and the lowest sole approximately y=1393: the head-plus-hair unit is about 476 px over a 1244 px standing height, approximately 38.3 percent or 2.61 heads tall. This exceeds the frozen 36-percent ceiling and is not unambiguously inside 32-36 percent.
Exactly one full-body subject is present, with complete hair and head, both empty hands, both legs, and both boots fully contained inside generous safe margins.

The broad planted three-quarter ready-idle, separated empty hands, compact soft-round silhouette, split crop, lilac vest mass, divided tails, and sturdy boots read clearly at combat-icon scale without a weapon.

Everyday fitted cloth, plain trousers, modest hardware, and practical flexible boots remain grounded and mortal; no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect appears.
